title: My cart
emptyHint: Pick a room on a listing page and use "Add to cart" to book several rooms or properties with a single payment.
totalNotice: Taxes included. All rooms are held together and confirmed with one payment; if one is unavailable, none are booked.
lockedNotice: The cart is held for payment. Release the rooms to make changes.

add.hint: Book several rooms or properties with one payment.
add.loginHint: You'll be asked to sign in to add to your cart; your selections are kept.

checkout.title: Complete your booking
checkout.holdHint: First we reserve all the rooms for you together for a limited time (all or nothing). You are not charged at this step; the end time of the hold is shown in the next step.
checkout.heldUntil: All rooms are held for you until {time}.
checkout.priceChanged: The price changed. Review the new total and try again.
checkout.itemUnavailable: One of the rooms is no longer available; no rooms were held.
checkout.declined: Payment declined; the rooms were released. You can hold them again and try another card.
checkout.expired: The hold expired and the rooms were released. You can restore the cart and hold the rooms again.
checkout.confirmPending: Your payment was received; the booking confirmation is being completed.
checkout.successHint: A total of {amount} was charged in a single payment.
checkout.noCart: There is no cart to pay.
checkout.remaining: ({minutes, plural, =0 {less than 1 minute left} one {# minute left} other {# minutes left}})
checkout.expiringSoon: Less than 2 minutes are left on your hold. Complete the payment now.
checkout.expiredHint: The rooms are no longer reserved for you. Hold them again to continue to payment.
checkout.rehold: Press "Hold rooms" to hold the rooms again.
checkout.expiredNoCart: The cart closed because the hold expired. You can restore the cart and hold the rooms again.
checkout.reopened: The cart was restored. Hold the rooms to continue to payment.
checkout.pendingWait: The booking confirmation will complete within a few seconds. This page updates by itself; do not pay again.
checkout.pendingSlow: Confirmation is taking longer than expected. Your payment was received; do not pay again. Your bookings will appear in My trips once confirmed and we will email you.
checkout.itemUnavailableNamed: {name} ({dates}) is no longer available; no rooms were held. Remove this room to hold the others, or choose other dates or another room.
checkout.itemUnavailableRow: This room is no longer available.
checkout.priceChangedTotal: The price changed: total {previous} → {current}. Rooms with an updated price are marked in the summary; review the new total and hold the rooms again.

checkout.nextStepsHint: Once the rooms are held, you can pay the total with one card or split the payment with your group.
checkout.payOptions: You can pay the total below with one card. If you want each participant to pay their own share:
checkout.successSplitHint: The total of {amount} was collected from the participants' shares.
checkout.successPaidHint: This cart has been paid. Total: {amount}.
checkout.noCartPaidHint: If you just paid for this cart, you can find your bookings in My trips.
checkout.verifyEmailFirst: You need to verify your email address before you can hold the rooms and pay. The verification link is in your inbox; if you can't find it, send it again.
checkout.payMethodLegend: How would you like to pay?
checkout.payMethodCard: I'll pay the full amount (one card)
checkout.payMethodSplit: We'll split it as a group (everyone pays their own share)
checkout.threeDsNoCode: Didn't get a code? Wait a few minutes. If it still doesn't arrive, you can try another card below or release the hold.
checkout.timeoutCheck: The request timed out; your payment may have gone through. We're checking your payment status… If the cart is still awaiting payment, you can try again; the same payment won't be taken twice.

split.title: Split the payment with your group
split.intro: Each participant pays their own share with their own card. Once every share is in, all rooms are confirmed together.
split.remainderHint: Leftover cents are added to your share.
split.fallbackOrganizer: Unpaid shares fall to you at the deadline (you pay the rest).
split.fallbackRefund: If shares are missing at the deadline, every payment is refunded and the rooms are released.

status.AUTHORIZED: Reserved on card, not charged yet

planStatus.FALLBACK: Remaining amount is on the organizer

share.title: Group booking share
share.notYours: This payment link was sent to someone else.
share.verifyEmail: Verify your email address to pay.
share.from: {name} invited you to a group booking.
share.authorized: Your share is reserved on your card; nothing has been charged yet. Once every share is in, the booking is confirmed and your card is charged.
share.confirmed: Every share is paid — the booking is confirmed!
share.closed: This split payment is no longer open.
share.alreadyPaid: This share has already been paid.
share.declined: Card declined; you can try again with another card.
share.threeDsIntro: Your bank wants you to approve this payment. Enter the verification code sent to your phone.
share.resendSent: We sent a verification link to your email address. Click the link in the email, then refresh this page.
share.alreadyVerified: Your email address is already verified. Refresh the page and try again.
share.resendFailed: We couldn't send the verification email. Please try again shortly.
share.switchAccount: Sign out and sign in with the invited account
share.invalidHelp: Make sure you opened the complete link exactly as it appears in the email or message. If it still doesn't work, ask the organizer for a new link.
share.expiredHelp: This link can no longer be used because the payment deadline has passed. If you still want to join the booking, ask the organizer for a new link.
share.notYoursHelp: To pay, you need to sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to.

share.paidByOther: This share has already been paid from another account; you don't need to pay.
share.aborted: This split payment was cancelled. If you paid, the reserved amount is released or refunded.

cancelConfirmBody: All rooms in the cart will be removed and the cart will be closed. This can't be undone.
cancelConfirmHeld: The rooms are currently held for you. If you empty the cart, the rooms are released and the cart is closed. If you started a group payment, participants' payments are cancelled and refunded. This can't be undone.

announce.removed: {name} was removed from the cart. New total: {total}
announce.released: The rooms were released. You can now edit the cart.
announce.restored: {name} was added back to the cart. New total: {total}

errors.CART_LOCKED: The cart is held for payment. To make changes, first press "Release the rooms".
errors.CART_NOT_OPEN: This cart can no longer be changed. Refresh the page to see its latest state.
errors.CONCURRENT_UPDATE: The cart was changed somewhere else at the same time. We loaded the latest version, please try again.
errors.CONFLICT: The cart was changed somewhere else at the same time. We loaded the latest version, please try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the details are invalid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This room is no longer in your cart. We loaded the latest version of your cart.
errors.CART_NOT_HELD: The cart is no longer held for payment. Hold the rooms again and retry.
errors.CART_PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: A payment for this cart is already in progress. Wait a few seconds and refresh the page.
errors.CART_NOT_CONFIRMABLE: The cart can no longer be confirmed. Go back to the cart and check its status.
errors.FRAUD_BLOCKED: This payment could not be made because of a security check. Try another card or contact support.
errors.NO_PENDING_CHALLENGE: There is no payment waiting for verification. Start the payment again.
errors.CHALLENGE_FAILED: The verification code is wrong. Check the code and try again.

released: The rooms were released and are no longer reserved for you.
releasedSplit: The split payment was cancelled and the rooms were released. Payments already made will be cancelled or refunded.

releaseConfirm.title: Release the rooms?
releaseConfirm.body: The rooms will no longer be reserved for you and someone else may book them. To pay, you will need to hold them again.
releaseConfirm.splitBody: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has paid their share yet.} one {# payment made so far ({funded}) will be cancelled or refunded.} other {# payments made so far ({funded}) will be cancelled or refunded.}} Invite links will stop working and the rooms will be released. This cannot be undone.

loadFailedHint: We can't show your cart right now. Check your connection and try again.
reopenNone: There is no expired cart to restore. Carts you emptied yourself can't be restored.
lockedNoticeUntil: The cart is held for payment until {time}. Release the rooms to make changes.
lockedNoticeSplit: The cart is held for payment until {time} and a split payment is in progress. If you release the rooms, the split payment is cancelled and any payments already made are cancelled or refunded.
